verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Inkwell & Lantern logo to an unreadable speck jammed into the card's top-left corner, so the brand is effectively lost. It also crams the body copy, CTA and tiny fine print into one row where they compete with each other, and leaves dead space under them. B keeps the logo intact and the hierarchy clear (kicker, then headline, body copy, a prominent CTA and subordinate fine print), and the book deliberately overlaps the card. However, B's card bleeds off the left, right and bottom edges, the fine print is jammed against the bottom of the canvas, and the confetti band at the top is cramped.
